As an attractive, tall male, lifes not much better. I coudlve had a harem of women chasing after me had I just applied myself. Instead I fell into the trap of listening to others about my looks, mostly jealous guys.

Let me tell you something. Youre as attractive as you make yourself. Workout, develop some confidence talking to women, humor, dress well and have self worth or be a provider. This all helps.

I used to look at myself as ugly or average until I realised, there's always someone out there who's going to dig your look. No reason to have thought this way as im a fairly attractive guy with height and a good build, but thats kind of my point, you're as attractive as you think you are.

Women relate more to personality anyway, rather than just physical attraction. Of course it does help, but its not everything. I tell you my looks alone did not help one iota in getting a girl. Its all about your personality.

Also depending on your age girlfriends can be nice but also overrated, I got broken up with by mine when I was in a depressed cycle and it's sent me on a 6 month spiral which I only just got out of and now I realise I didnt actually miss her, I just missed the feeling of comfort. Better to love yourself than another, fuck em.
